result.title: From data to decisions: how LSEG is scaling trusted AI
result.description:
What happens when one of the world's leading financial markets infrastructure and data providers combines trusted market intelligence with AI?

In this customer story, LSEG shares how it's using ChatGPT Enterprise and OpenAI APIs to accelerate insight generation, speed up product innovation, and help employees and customers make better decisions with confidence.

Hear from Emily Prince, Group Head of Enterprise AI, and Max Grigoryev, Group Director AI Products, as they discuss scaling AI responsibly, transforming workflows, and bringing trusted financial data into AI-powered experiences.

Read the full story: www.openai.com/index/lseg

result.title: How Preply combines AI and human tutors to personalize learning
result.description:
What happens when one of the world's largest language-learning platforms combines human expertise with AI?

In this customer story, Preply shares how it's using OpenAI to create more personalized learning experiences for learners around the world—while giving tutors more time to focus on teaching, motivation, and human connection.

Hear from Preply's Co-founder & CTO, Dmytro Voloshyn, Staff Product Manager, Emily Stott, and tutor Michelle Garcia Ramos as they discuss how AI is transforming language learning and helping build a future that is human-led and AI-enabled.

Read the full story: www.openai.com/index/preply

result.title: Debug web apps with browser use in Codex
result.description:
Codex can now use the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) in Browser Use to inspect console logs, runtime errors, local storage, applied styling, network traffic, and performance profiles while working on web applications.

In this demo, Codex investigates a slow chat app by profiling interactions and inspecting network requests, then fixes the issues and supports the changes with clear measurements.

To use this functionality, enable Developer mode in the Browser settings of your Codex app and approve CDP access when Codex starts inspecting a website.

Learn more here: https://developers.openai.com/codex/app/browser#developer-mode

result.title: Life Near OpenAI's Stargate Project
result.description:
For more than 40 years, Tom and Lisa Perini have welcomed visitors to their ranch and restaurant in Buffalo Gap, Texas, just outside Abilene.

As new investment and AI infrastructure arrive in the region, they've seen firsthand how growth can create new opportunities for local businesses while raising important questions about preserving the character of rural communities.

In this conversation, the Perinis reflect on what makes their community special, why they believe small towns need opportunity to thrive, and how they think about balancing growth with the traditions and way of life they hope will endure for generations to come.
